$Comment: No Light to Follow: win a Relight and Escape round on the Hardcore preset. Earned once and kept.
INSTANCE_ROUND_WON fires once for every player who wins a round, with Target <mod id>:<mode id>
(kweebec:chase for Relight and Escape) and Qualifier the preset id, so Qualifier hardcore keeps the
other presets out. Change the Qualifier to nightmare to ask for a Nightmare win instead, or drop it
to count a win on any preset.
It pays the title Kweebec_Unbroken through the Title reward kind, on unlock: a title is the one
thing an achievement pays without waiting to be collected. The round itself already pays its spoils,
